title: Maintain an hPSC culture without spontaneous differentiation
summary: Rehearse a gated synthetic maintenance loop with intake quarantine, daily morphology and feeding decisions, defined-matrix handling, clump passage, periodic QC and privacy-safe records.
scenario: An entirely synthetic hPSC-like line arrives with an alias and categorical transfer/QC records. Review consent and transfer restrictions, then submit all four intake assessments. The line remains quarantined unless the bundle is complete and synthetic mycoplasma is not detected. Over three days, score displayed density and differentiated areas, remove those areas selectively, feed daily and decide when to passage. Some runs have a hidden degrading source matrix or positive intake result. Prepare a defined destination matrix, allocate 156 clumps across six wells, repeat the QC bundle and close traceable synthetic records. This does not authorize or certify hPSC work.
guided_steps: Review the synthetic MTA alias, consent scope, transfer restrictions and provenance. Missing permissions end the run in quarantine.
Request intake mycoplasma, STR identity, karyotype and undifferentiated-marker assessments. All four plus a not-detected mycoplasma result are required for release.
On each of three days, read the publicly displayed current density and differentiated area, enter those values exactly, then selectively remove the full displayed differentiated area.
Record a complete medium change every day. A missed or omitted feed creates one stress/index penalty even on a passage day, but its morphology increment applies only when a later panel exists.

Continue on days 1 and 2. On day 3, passage in the synthetic 70–85% density window and complete the day; choose matrix investigation if recurrent differentiation indicates that problem. Every passage day, including an early-passage branch, must be completed before coating.
Coat the destination with the new synthetic matrix lot using cold liquid handling, complete even coverage and no drying.
Passage as small clumps with 2–3 gentle triturations. Allocate 156/6 = 26 clumps per well; do not default to single cells.
Submit periodic mycoplasma, STR, karyotype and undifferentiated-marker QC. Marker consistency is not functional proof of pluripotency.
Record SYNTH_HPSC_A, MED_SYNTH_01, the actual destination matrix lot, passage 13, the real observation-day count and any deviation.
Acknowledge that this synthetic maintenance loop does not authorize or certify hPSC work, then finish for a formative debrief.

sources.use: Link-only perspective for acquisition, consent/transfer context, authentication, genomic monitoring, undifferentiated-state interpretation and reporting; no text adapted.
Official December 2023 Standards landing page and update link for high-level scope only; strictly copyrighted full Standards remain link-only.
Existing, distinct link-only ethics/governance reference for consent and permissible-use boundaries; not the 2023 basic-research Standards.
Copyrighted link-only reference for feeder-free matrix, morphology, daily observation/feeding and aggregate-passaging concepts; no protocol text, figure or numeric procedure copied.
NIST public-information page paraphrased for STR identity testing only; STR does not establish genomic stability or pluripotency.

limitations: Formative-only synthetic state machine. It does not authorize or certify hPSC work, establish competency, replace supervised training or satisfy institutional biosafety/ethics requirements.
No real cells, donor identifiers, clinical details, consent documents, STR profiles or genomic data are accepted or produced.

Density windows, three-day rhythm, exact differentiation areas, penalties, clump counts, lot labels, QC interval and categorical results are simulation choices, not laboratory acceptance criteria or a validated protocol.
Missed-feed and matrix effects are arbitrary deterministic consequences, not hPSC growth, differentiation, viability, matrix-degradation or recovery kinetics.
The ISSCR perspective and December 2023 Standards are both link-only in this package; no Standards or perspective text, checklist, table or figure is reproduced or adapted.
ATCC remains copyrighted link-only; no manufacturer matrix, medium, dissociation or feeding protocol is reproduced. NIST informs STR identity only, not hPSC maintenance competence.
No functional pluripotency assay, real karyotype interpretation, contamination diagnosis, clinical use or release decision is modelled.
Unrequested assays return only not_requested in event data, event text and visible panels; they reveal no underlying categorical or hidden outcome and are not described as performed.
Only the current awaiting-score panel exposes current density and differentiated area; completed days are immutable and destination coating requires the passage day’s completed flag.
